name: AI Tools Saver

sources.title: Submit page — 'Submit your AI tool and reach thousands of AI users. We offer a 50% OFF for the first 1000 companies' (page serves a summarized markdown rendition to agents)
Homepage — curated AI tools directory with verified discounts/deals; every tool page lists vendor website, pricing model, categories and active deals
Third-party directory table — aitoolsaver.com marked 'Paid' (observed Aug 2026)

requirements: AI tool with a live website; directory focus is tools with deals/discounts/promo codes
A deal or discount is the editorial angle — tool pages highlight active deals
Submission appears to be paid: '50% OFF for the first 1000 companies' implies a standard listing fee; third-party directories corroborate 'Paid'
preparation: Tool name, vendor website URL, pricing model, and category
A deal/promo code or discount to feature — core value proposition of this directory
workflow: Open aitoolsaver.com/submit-ai-tool in a real browser (the markdown rendition omits the form and payment details)
Complete the submission form and pay the discounted listing fee if applicable
Provide deal details so the tool page can list an active discount
Confirm the tool page appears under the relevant category
watchFor: Exact fee not visible in agent-friendly rendition — confirm the real price in-browser before paying
'50% off first 1000 companies' is a urgency promo — verify it still applies
Site is deal-aggregator themed; a listing without a real discount underuses the format
Affiliate marketing disclosed on the site
countsAsLive: A dedicated tool page on aitoolsaver.com lists the vendor website, pricing model, categories and deal
